attributes.action: An Appeal for Fairness: Equal Rights for Every Skilled Worker
attributes.additional_details:
We chose to build our lives here in good faith, paying our taxes and contributing thousands upfront in massive visa and health surcharge (IHS) fees. Yet, our hard work is being measured only by a paycheck.
Our children were born on this soil. This country is their only homeland; our ancestral countries are foreign to them. Uprooting them now forces innocent children into deep cultural alienation.
If the government can rightfully show compassion to asylum seekers, it must show basic fairness to legal immigrants who do everything right. We call for standardized visa rights and permanent stability for all skilled worker families, completely irrespective of title or wage.
attributes.background: Stop moving the goalposts for legal skilled workers and our UK-born kids. We call on the Government to guarantee equal rights and permanent stability for all tax-paying visa holders, regardless of salary or title, so our families can grow up securely in the only home country they have ever known.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do to "to guarantee equal rights and permanent stability for all tax-paying visa holders".

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do.

You may wish to sign the following petitions: 

"Protect the five-year ILR route for existing Skilled Workers" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785621

"Legislate to protect ILR applicants from retrospective changes" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/775267
